✨ Notre Histoire

A Hidden Enchanted Pâtisserie

🎀

Born from a deep love for French and Italian artisan traditions, Le Artisan Boulangerie is more than a bakery — it's a magical destination where each croissant is folded with care, each bread is baked with intention, and every dessert tells a love story.

Step through our doors and discover handcrafted macarons, buttery croissants, artisan breads, curated charcuterie boards, and a cozy bistro that feels like a Parisian dream right here in Anand.

🌸 Why We're Magical

Six Reasons to Fall in Love

🦋
🥐

Handcrafted Pastries

Every croissant, macaron, and tart is made from scratch using traditional French and Italian techniques.

🌸

Enchanting Atmosphere

Frescoed ceilings, pink velvet seating, chandeliers and dried flowers — a setting straight from a fairytale.

🧀

Artisan Fromagerie

Curated charcuterie boards, imported cheeses, and premium accompaniments for the discerning palate.

🎂

Celebration Cakes

Custom artisan cakes and desserts for every occasion, crafted to make your moments unforgettable.

☕

Cosy Bistro

A multi-floor dining experience with a warm, intimate bistro where every meal feels like a Parisian afternoon.

🛍️

Artisan Épicerie

Take home artisan breads, specialty jams, fine coffees, and curated gourmet products from our boutique shelf.

🍰 Notre Menu

A Menu Full of Wonder

🌷

Each item crafted with love, inspired by French & Italian traditions.

🤍
🥐 Pastries
Beurre Croissant
Classic French butter croissant, laminated to golden perfection — flaky outside, pillowy within.
🤍
🧁 Pastries
Cranberry Cream Muffin
Soft muffin swirled with cream cheese, topped with tart cranberry jewels and vanilla glaze.
🤍
🍰 Desserts
Dark Chocolate Cheesecake
Velvet cheesecake on dark brownie base, crowned with rich Belgian chocolate drizzle.
🤍
🎂 Desserts
Artisan Cake Collection
Changing daily selection of beautifully crafted cakes from opera to raspberry cheesecake.
🤍
🍮 Desserts
Torched Meringue Tart
Cloud-like meringue torched to golden perfection over a silky lemon curd pastry shell.
🤍
🍞 Breads
Artisan Bagels
Hand-rolled bagels with everything, sesame, and herb toppings — served with house cream cheese.
🤍
🍞 Breads
Rosemary Focaccia & More
Rosemary focaccia, beetroot bread, sourdough, multigrain — baked fresh every morning.
🤍
🍝 Bistro
Pesto Penne Pasta
House-made basil pesto with roasted cherry tomatoes, olives, and parmesan over al dente penne.
🤍
🧀 Boards
Artisan Charcuterie Board
Curated selection of cheeses, crackers, olives, grapes, fresh vegetables & house-made dips.
🤍
🧀 Boards
Grande Grazing Board
Our showstopper feast board — meats, cheeses, fruits, nuts, dips, and artisan crackers.
